text: This solution, Natural Hazards Commission Toka Tū Ake (NHC) – National Reinsurance Purchase for NHCover addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in New Zealand between Natural Hazards Commission Toka Tū Ake (NHC), International reinsurance markets, and Insurance-linked securities (ILS) investors via Totara Re Pte. Ltd.. The program was implemented in 2025 and focuses on collaboration and regulation.
